answer: A real operator goes idle — no input for a while — and then resumes with a characteristic re-orientation pause. The network detects idle periods and checks the resumption pattern; a session that never idles, or resumes instantly every time, is scored as a script that never rests. The system trusts a shale only after its actions survive the consistency check. The pearl keeps the process honest and the hollow keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
